title: Validate the fire feature plane across multiple fire seasons
unblocked_by: Exact fire archive reconciliation completed 2026-08-27: 9,428 calendar days, 8,359 data days, 1,069 governed absences, and 3,039,749 detections.
note: Runnable, not complete. The historical fire-data gap is closed, but AUC 0.725 was still fit and scored on 2026 alone. This track must implement held-out-season validation, calibration, coverage weighting, and MODIS/VIIRS normalization before the fire-risk surface can support funding claims.

slices.task: Out-of-season validation harness -- fit on year set A, score on held-out year B
Calibration -- turn the raw index into a probability with a reliability curve

shared_writes.reason: the feature builder is parameterised by year here; s1 owns that edit so s2 never races it

tripwires: detection coverage is NOT uniform across years -- 2000 has 35 days, 2003 has 1; an unweighted multi-year fit silently weights 2002 over 2000 by ~8x
the upstream feed caps records per request and drops the excess silently, biting hardest on the largest fire days
ignition is not in the model; a year with an unusual lightning outbreak will look like model failure and is not
